class: a by-value ground moved after the claim rested on it

expect.why: the note the claim rests on was remeasured after the entry landed; D45 by value, with the anchor the digest of the section rather than the commit that carried it

the flag exists to force the choice: a reading anchored by value if the claim survives, or a refutation if it does not. resolve passes at both commits, since the founding text is in the tree at commit 01 and in the history at commit 02

history: apply commits/01, commits/02, … as successive commits in a fresh repository; expectations name the commit they apply to. `@commitNN` in an entry is substituted with the real short object id of that commit before it is made, because a seed cannot know an id the runner has not created yet
